scientific_integrity: Complete parameter and real-zero classification is proved by an elementary Fourier phase identity. Finite computational checks are supplementary, not a replacement for the all-parameter analytic argument.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two positive-length, unweighted real intervals separated by a positive gap; real frequency zeros only; no discrete-translate or more-interval assertion. Full text of the motivating manuscript could not be inspected, and an older equivalent description remains possible.
title: Arithmetic Fourier-zero lattices and Wiener cyclicity for two separated intervals
